day.headline: A Ox day — Snake and Rooster are in step.

reasons: Snake and Ox share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Collect it tonight. In bed by ten, nothing left to discuss.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: an early night that never happens
signs.message: The early night you keep rescheduling. Cancel the nine o'clock thing.

reasons: Rat pairs with Ox — a harmonious day
signs.message: The optical shop fixes that in two minutes. Go today.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Just ask her how she did it. Curiosity beats seething.

reasons: Rooster and Ox share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Nobody uses it. Take your call down there, fully uninterrupted.

reasons: Goat opposes Ox — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: the dread before a phone call
signs.message: The dread lasts longer than the call. Dial, then breathe.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Open it, keep three things, recycle the rest. Twenty minutes.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a list with two items crossed off
signs.message: Two down. Pick the smallest one left, then close the app.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: doing one thing slowly on purpose
signs.message: Do one thing at half speed today. Start with the matcha.

reasons: Ox's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Somebody's parked in your spot. Let them, take the row behind.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Root-bound, sure, but that's a spring job. Water it, walk away.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Half that closet's for July. Wear the same sweater again, happily.
